quest.title: Good Medicine Tastes Bitter
quest.description: Chenxiang's daughter Hongdou refuses to take her medicine. Perhaps a spoonful of Almond Tofu could help the medicine go down...

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Doudou, be a good girl, you'll only get better if you take your medicine...

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: No! I don't want to! I hate it, it tastes gross...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Oh, hello Traveler. Doudou is quite a sickly child. This is the medicine she needs to take, according to the prescription Dr. Baizhu gave me.

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: But she refuses to take it. She complains she doesn't like the taste... *sigh* Unfortunately, herbal medicine is bitter, that's just how it is...

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: The only time she ever agrees to take it is if she gets to have a bowl of Almond Tofu afterwards.

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you have the time, could you go and pick me up a portion of Almond Tofu? I should stay here — I may still need to talk her into it...

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: Thank you. Just one portion for Doudou is enough.

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: *sigh* I wish I knew. Whatever it is, Dr. Baizhu says it's nearly impossible to cure, and that just keeping the symptoms at bay takes a lot of medication.

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: I fear she might need to take medicine her whole life. And starting at such a young age... It doesn't bear thinking about.

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: I just wish I were the one with the illness... But the best I can hope for is that things don't get any worse for the poor child.

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: Anyway. Please go and fetch me a portion of Almond Tofu, just the one will do.

choices.text: Hey kiddo. Not liking the medicine, huh?

response.speaker: Hongdou
response.text: It's sooooo bitter!!! Lulu's medicine is way less bitter than mine!

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: Doudou... Lulu and her friends were just pretending. That wasn't real medicine they were drinking, it was some leftover sugary water from a bowl of Almond Tofu.

response.speaker: Hongdou
response.text: Oh... So Almond Tofu won't make me get better? Then... I guess I do have to take that icky medicine...

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: That's right! Good girl. As soon as you're better you can eat whatever you like!

response.speaker: Hongdou
response.text: Why can't they make medicine taste sweet like Almond Tofu? So unfair...

response.speaker: Chenxiang
response.text: *sigh* There's no getting through to her... Anyway. Please go and fetch me a portion of Almond Tofu, just the one will do.

talks.objective: Give the Almond Tofu to Chenxiang

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
